description:
Please review this one-sentence help-center text for our Offline Sync feature (ships in version 4.2):

"Offline Sync let you works without internet and it sync later automatic."

Scope: Check grammar, clarity, and tone for a user-facing help-center article. List each problem you find, then give a corrected version of the sentence (one or two options are fine). Keep the meaning: users can work without an internet connection, and their changes sync automatically when they reconnect. Don't add claims about conflict handling, platforms, or settings; those haven't been confirmed.

Done when: You have sent your findings and the suggested rewrite back to me, the Release Manager (/release_manager).
